name: piclaw
description: Personal pi coding agent assistant. Lightweight nanoclaw-style orchestrator using Bun and pi.

scripts.typecheck: bun runtime/scripts/repo-dev-command.ts typecheck && bun runtime/scripts/repo-dev-command.ts typecheck:scripts && bun runtime/scripts/repo-dev-command.ts typecheck:web-settings && bun runtime/scripts/repo-dev-command.ts typecheck:web-panes && bun run typecheck:web-compose
scripts.build:vendor:mermaid: cd runtime && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/beautiful-mermaid.json
scripts.build:vendor:pele: cd runtime && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/pele.json && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/pele-license.json && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/diagram-sanitizer-license.json
scripts.build:vendor:codemirror: cd runtime && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/codemirror-editor.json
scripts.build:vendor:preact-htm: cd runtime && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/preact-htm.json
scripts.build:vendor:marked: cd runtime && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/marked-global.json
scripts.build:vendor:katex: cd runtime && bun run scripts/build-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/katex-global.json
scripts.build:vendor: bun run check:vendor:xterm && bun run build:vendor:mermaid && bun run build:vendor:pele && bun run build:vendor:codemirror && bun run build:vendor:preact-htm && bun run build:vendor:marked && bun run build:vendor:katex && bun run build:vendor:katex-assets && bun run build:vendor:terminal-fonts && bun run build:vendor:remote-display-decoder && bun run build:vendor:office-viewer
scripts.update:vendor:mermaid: cd runtime && bun run scripts/update-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/beautiful-mermaid.json
scripts.update:vendor:pele: cd runtime && bun run scripts/update-vendored-dependency.ts --manifest vendor-manifests/pele.json
scripts.build:web: bun run build:vendor && cd runtime && rm -rf web/static/classic/dist web/static/common/dist && mkdir -p web/static/classic/dist web/static/common/dist && bun build web/src/app.ts web/src/dev/settings-widget-fixture.ts web/src/dev/session-picker-fixture.ts --target=browser --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --external "#editor-vendor/codemirror" --outdir web/static/classic/dist --entry-naming="[name].bundle.js" && bun build extensions/viewers/editor/editor-extension.ts --target=browser --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --external "#editor-vendor/codemirror" --outdir web/static/classic/dist --entry-naming="editor.bundle.js" && bun build web/src/login.ts --target=browser --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --outdir web/static/common/dist --entry-naming="[name].bundle.js" && bun build web/src/styles/app.css --target=browser --minify --sourcemap --outdir web/static/classic/dist --entry-naming="[name].bundle.css" && bun build web/src/styles/login.css --target=browser --minify --sourcemap --outdir web/static/common/dist --entry-naming="[name].bundle.css" && rm -rf web/static/common/js/components web/static/common/js/utils web/static/common/js/ui && rm -f web/static/common/js/app.js web/static/common/js/api.js web/static/common/js/markdown.js && bun run scripts/stamp-cache-buster.ts
scripts.test:raw: bun run test:local --cwd runtime --env PICLAW_DB_IN_MEMORY=1 -- bun test --max-concurrency=1
scripts.test:controlled: bun run test:local -- bun run runtime/scripts/controlled-test-runner.ts
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf runtime/generated/coverage && bun run test:local --cwd runtime --env PICLAW_DB_IN_MEMORY=1 -- bun test --max-concurrency=1 --coverage --coverage-dir=generated/coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov
scripts.test:optional:browser-isolation: bun run test:local --cwd runtime --env PICLAW_DB_IN_MEMORY=1 --env PICLAW_RUN_OPTIONAL_BROWSER_TESTS=1 -- bun test --max-concurrency=1 --timeout=30000 test/channels/web/browser-chat-isolation.optional.test.ts
scripts.check:vendor-inventory: bun run scripts/vendor-inventory.ts --check && bun run scripts/check-vendor-compressed.ts && bun run scripts/check-vendor-metadata.ts
scripts.ci:fast: bun run check:silent-swallows && bun run check:structured-logging && bun run check:dependency-pins && bun run check:actions-workflows && bun run check:vendor-inventory && bun run check:env-surface && bun run check:circular-dependencies && bun run check:local-test-entrypoints && bun run ci:fast:tests && bun run ci:fast:features && make build-web
scripts.ci:full: bun run ci:fast && bun run ci:native
scripts.ci:fast:tests: bun run test:local --cwd runtime --env PICLAW_DB_IN_MEMORY=1 -- bun test --max-concurrency=1 --path-ignore-patterns='**/features/**' --path-ignore-patterns='**/scripts/**' --path-ignore-patterns='**/*.optional.test.ts'
scripts.quality: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:pack-hygiene && bun run check:stale-dist && bun run check:import-boundaries && bun run check:env-surface && bun run check:circular-dependencies && bun run check:unused-exports && bun run check:hook-tdz && bun run check:silent-swallows && bun run check:structured-logging
scripts.build:web:visual: cd runtime && bun web/static/visual/frontend/build.ts && bun build web/static/visual/frontend/styles/app.css --target=browser --minify --sourcemap --outdir web/static/visual/dist --entry-naming="[name].bundle.css"
